intro_section.title: Private Transfer From Liberia Airport to Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica
paragraphs: Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica is the 24-hour all-inclusive beachfront resort on golden-sand Playa Matapalo. Guests flying into Daniel Oduber Quiros International Airport (LIR) can book a private transfer straight to the resort, typically 41 to 53 minutes by car.

Wild Papagayo skips the shared shuttle model entirely: your vehicle and driver are reserved only for your group, driving straight to the beachfront resort on Playa Matapalo without stopping at other hotels first.

Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica is a separate property from Hotel Riu Guanacaste, even though both sit close together on Playa Matapalo. If you're booked into Riu Guanacaste, use the dedicated transfer page linked below instead.

travel_times.title: Liberia Airport to Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica: Travel Time
travel_times.note: The return drive from Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica to Liberia Airport takes about the same time. Actual travel time can vary with traffic and road conditions.
travel_times.source_note: Google Routes data places the drive at approximately 41–53 minutes (33.2 km) from Daniel Oduber Quiros International Airport (LIR) to Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica.

hotel_pickup.title: Reserve Private Transportation to Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica
hotel_pickup.text: Once you land at LIR and clear customs, your Wild Papagayo driver will be waiting in the arrivals area with a personalized sign, ready for the drive out to the beachfront resort on golden-sand Playa Matapalo.
hotel_pickup.text_2: For your return flight, share your departure time and hotel checkout details, and we'll have transportation ready at Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica for the drive back to Liberia Airport.

about_section.title: Staying at Riu Guanacaste Instead?
about_section.text: Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica and Hotel Riu Guanacaste are separate properties on Playa Matapalo. If you're staying at Riu Guanacaste, use our dedicated transfer page for accurate pickup information.

faq.q: How do I get from Liberia Airport to Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica?
faq.a: Wild Papagayo drives you directly from LIR to the beachfront resort on Playa Matapalo, about 41 to 53 minutes by private vehicle.

faq.q: Can I book a private transfer to Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica?
faq.a: Yes. A private vehicle and driver are arranged specifically for your arrival.

faq.q: Can I book transportation from Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica back to Liberia Airport?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us your departure flight time and checkout details, and we'll schedule your pickup from the resort.
At the designated arrivals pickup area at LIR, where your driver will be holding a personalized sign.

faq.q: Can families or groups book this transfer?
faq.a: Yes. Vehicle size is matched to your travel party in advance.

faq.q: How far in advance should I arrange transportation?
faq.a: Ideally as soon as your dates are confirmed. During high season, waiting time can increase if arranged last minute.
